podcast.body: This song, from the *Surfer Rosa* album, was co-written by Black Francis and bassist Kim Deal, with Deal unexpectedly singing lead vocals. It became a major fan favorite, frequently included in the Pixies' encores, and has been covered by other indie bands. In spring 2014, Apple used the track in a TV commercial for iPhones, iPads, and iPods, despite its lyrics describing a woman observing an attractive black man making love to another woman. The song's success contributed to the band's first breakup, as Kim Deal's desire to sing lead on more Pixies songs was opposed by Black Francis. "The most obvious was the song gigantic from Serfa Rosa the band's first album Kim co-wrote it with black Francis and she ended up singing lead to everybody's surprise"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: As an illustration of Steve Albini's unconventional recording methods, for bassist Kim Deal's vocals on "Gigantic," he eschewed traditional distance and echo effects. Instead, he had her sing the track in a bathroom, using the natural acoustics of the space to achieve the desired sound. "En lugar de usar efectos de distancia y eco para la voz de Kim Dill, bajista de la banda, le hizo cantar Gigantic de selvaño."
